card.description: Gross code is represented at T1 by the accepted 144-qubit Gross bivariate-bicycle member. The deterministic constructor validates the binary symplectic quotient and derives the displayed operator-incidence view from those same checks. Decoder, operation, relation, and realization facets remain unsurveyed.

views.description: Qubits and stabilizer rows are joined exactly when the executable binary symplectic row has support. This is operator incidence, not asserted spatial or hardware geometry.
